posts.zh:
dsh-client-auto-retry 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。回合中断自动续跑：turn/end 因 error / interrupted / max-tokens 结束时自动发送「继续」，支持宽限期、冷却、连续次数上限、启动扫描与设置卡片；不切换模型/provider。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-f60146621ac097f9e424.html
posts.en:
dsh-client-auto-retry is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Auto-resumes interrupted DSH turns: sends a queued 「继续」 after turn/end with error, interrupted or max-tokens reasons, with a grace period, cooldown, a consecutive-attempts cap, boot-time scanning and a settings card; it never switches models or providers.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-f60146621ac097f9e424.html
